citation: Cerbai–Claesson–Ernst–Golab, Pattern-avoiding Cayley permutations via combinatorial species, Australasian Journal of Combinatorics 94(2) (2026), 267–299
containment: Strictly increasing distinct subsequence positions; preserve order comparisons and equalities of letters.
scope: For all packed patterns p,q of equal length with max(p)<=max(q), and every word length n, the number of packed length-n words avoiding p is at least the number avoiding q.
